entity: Las Vegas Sands' Texas media/ad spending tied to its casino lobbying push, 2021-26
what_we_add: $20,575,810.66 across 62 monthly lobby reports filed under Andy Abboud, May 2021-Jun 2026; 70-71% of all Texas lobby media spending (everyone else $8.26M); about 4x Sands' federal lobby fees
why:
Texas Tribune (Apr and Jun 2021) and Texas Standard (2025) name Sands and report a big, nonstop Texas ad campaign: same finding, same direction.
No quote has the lobby-report total, the Abboud filing, or the share of all Texas lobby media; the Tribune's 'at least $2M' covers only 2021 against our 5-year total, so it can't be lined up as a contradiction.
